engine_meta.peak_rss_source: max over sessions of VmHWM, reset to the current RSS at run_arm entry (/proc/self/clear_refs 5)

telemetry_window: timed run: begin right before t0, end right after the final device sync

timing_definitions.engine_import_s: import of the engine modules (torch + engines, or numba + engine)
timing_definitions.fr_time_s_at_save: cumulative device time inside the FR blocks (CUDA events / perf_counter); NaN = not measurable (numba)
timing_definitions.import_s: process start (/proc) to run_one entry (interpreter start-up + numpy + this module)
timing_definitions.monitor_s: gpu_torch: nvidia-smi sampling at saves (device idle), excluded from every stamp and the total
timing_definitions.peak_gpu_device_mb: nvidia-smi used_memory of this process (context + workspaces + allocator cache), max over the samples during and right after the timed run
timing_definitions.peak_rss_mb: host VmHWM; torch backends: reset right before the timed run, read right after it
timing_definitions.process_wall_s: process start (/proc) to the end of the run (before writing): the allocated device time
timing_definitions.wall_s_at_save: elapsed wall at each save (gateway: right after step k - 1; LTA: after the sub-chunk that evaluates step k, which includes k's move); device synchronised before each stamp
timing_definitions.wall_total_s: perf_counter from the start of the timed run to its end (after a device sync)
timing_definitions.warmup_s: one short run of the same code path before the timed run (JIT compile / numba cache load, CUDA kernel and library loading)
